facts.fact: Le Provincial reported on 24 September 2026 that the Bank of Algeria acted on 23 September under law no. 23-09 and regulation no. 25-02 on payment service providers, which lists services they may offer including payment accounts, transfers, card issuing, merchant acquiring and money transfer.
facts.system: Loi n° 23-09 and Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers

facts.fact: Le Provincial describes a payment service provider under regulation 25-02 as a new financial actor, not necessarily a bank, and reports that mobile operator subsidiary Djezzy Payment Services was authorised to constitute itself as one on 23 September 2026, with licensing (agrément) still to be applied for within 12 months.
facts.system: Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers
